title: Lena and the Kitchen
author: Z. M. Reyes
blurb: Coral Lockridge, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
